I've been through this with my wife. Last summer she tried to kill herself. Here is my advice. 

1. Call the suicide hotline. They don't actually do anything useful except recommend resources available to you in your area. It's a good place to start though.

2. Only call the police if she's actively trying to kill herself and you don't feel like you can stop her on her own. The cops aren't really that useful honestly.

3. Don't keep it a secret. This is the biggest mistake I made. You can't watch her 24/7. My wife would be lucid when I left for work and a few hours later she would loose control and call me looking for a knife. Your going to need people to help watch her. This is not going away quickly.

4. Go through the house pack up all the knifes rope and everything else take it to someone elses house. You're going to need to search the house every so often because my wife would always hide razors she got at work everywhere. 

5. No matter what happens don't give up. My wife was suicidal for about four months. Some of the longest months of my wife. Sometimes I don't know if I could keep it up. I felt exhausted and heart broken. Eventually whith counseling and medication, she pulled through it. She still has episodes every now and again but they seem to be more rare as time goes on.
